lessons.title: Weights and Quantities: Килограмм, Грамм, and Fresh Produce
lessons.cyrillicTitle: Purchase meat, root vegetables, and flour specifying exact metric weights and bagged quantities.
lessons.primaryPurpose: Introduce metric weight and bulk quantity units used at open markets: килограмм / кило 'kg', грамм 'g', хагас кило 'half kg', уут 'bag/sack', and fresh produce terms (төмс, лууван, сонгино, байцаа, мах).

lessons.title: Stall Negotiations: Нэг Кило нь Хэд вэ? and Checking Freshness
lessons.cyrillicTitle: Ask stall vendors for unit prices per kilo, verify freshness/origin, and politely negotiate minor bulk discounts.

lessons.title: Sacred Hands: Receiving Food and Tea with Two Hands (Хоёр Гараараа)
lessons.cyrillicTitle: Demonstrate verbal and cultural awareness of receiving food, tea, and gifts with both hands or supported elbow.
lessons.primaryPurpose: Introduce core Mongolian hospitality etiquette vocabulary: хоёр гар 'two hands', баруун гар 'right hand', тохой 'elbow', тулах 'to support (elbow)', хүндэтгэх 'to respect', and receiving customs (хоёр гараараа авах 'to take with both hands').

lessons.cyrillicTitle: Recognize and state core Mongolian dining taboos and ger rules, warning peers politely when necessary.
